summary: Iter 44 Competition Demo + Achievements Removal — ALL GREEN. Backend 12/12 pytest passed (pytest_iter44.xml). Fixed one Slovak leak in routes/healing.py (STEP_META recovery.title 'Zotavenie' → 'Recovery'). Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/dev-bypass returns session_token, /api/auth/me shows language='en' for founder. (2) POST /api/demo/seed → {ok:true, seeded:false} (idempotent as expected — already seeded). (3) GET /api/lifecard shows birth_date=1985-03-15, blood_type=A+; GET /api/emergency-profile blood_type=A+. (4) GET /api/calendar/timeline returns all 8 seeded records with EXACT English titles + dates: Flu vaccine 2023-10-15, Tetanus booster 2021-05-20, COVID-19 booster 2022-04-10, Knee arthroscopy 2019-08-12, Appendectomy 2012-03-25, Lab: Blood glucose 5.2 mmol/L 2024-01-15, Lab: Total cholesterol 4.8 mmol/L 2024-01-15, Annual physical examination 2026-09-15 (source=jarvis). (5) Lifecard predictions box contains {title:'Annual physical examination', suggested_date:'2026-09-15'}. (6) GET /api/achievements → 404 ✓ (system removed). (7) GET /api/streaks/physio → 200 with current/tier/freeze_available fields (moved module still registered). (8) GET /api/healing/state → journey.kind_label='Illness', steps_meta EN titles: Intake, Financial Shield, Access, Paperwork, Recovery. FRONTEND (390x844 web preview): (a) Login /login shows testID founder-bypass-btn; single tap logs in and routes to /(tabs). (b) Home: testID home-welcome-banner renders 'Guardian Angel OS · Your Personal Health Guardian'; testID demo-badge (top-right gold pill 'DEMO') visible by default; NO home-achievements testID present ✓; English labels confirmed on home: HEALING LOOP, DAILY BRIEFING, GUARDIAN LENS, tab bar HEALING / FAMILY SHIELD / VAULT, and Healing Loop steps INTAKE / FINANCIAL SHIELD / ACCESS / PAPERWORK / RECOVERY plus journey line 'Illness · General practitioner — Jarvis steers …'. (c) Tap pillar-health → hh-lifecard-hero → /health-timeline: header 'LIFE CARD', filter chips 'VACCINATION · DISEASE · SURGERY · INJURY · CHECK-UP' visible; all 8 seeded timeline entries present including 'Annual physical examination' rendered with '✨ PREDICTION' marker. (d) Profile: testID prof-demo-badge switch present in 'DEMO MODE' section; toggling OFF removes demo-badge overlay immediately; toggling ON restores it (AsyncStorage pub/sub verified via useDemoMode). (e) /achievements route not reachable — no trophy chip or navigation entry on home. Preserved warnings (pre-existing, unrelated): shadow*→boxShadow, expo-notifications web, props.pointerEvents. NOTE: On the /health-timeline (LIFE CARD) screen — which IS in the demo-critical path — some Slovak strings remain: 'MOJA KARTA' (chip), 'VEK', '41 r.' (age), 'TRENDY ZDRAVIA' button, 'PREDIKCIE · JARVIS' section header. These are the ONLY residual Slovak strings on demo-critical screens; main agent should polish for a fully English jury demo.
